The '''Twins''' was a violent binary [[Star system/Legends|star system]] situated along the [[Myto's Arrow/Legends|Myto's Arrow]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. It contained two dying [[Star/Legends|stars]]: a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] and a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]]. The intense [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] tides that surrounded the stars made the system unstable for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] passage, but the heavily fluctuating magnetic tides also had a side-effect of cloaking the altitude changes of vessels passing through the region, allowing starships that entered the system to change course without their maneuvers being detected by pursuers. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] planned to fly through the Twins while transporting the resistance leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. However, they were [[Ambush near the Twins|attacked]] close to the system by the forces of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that the Twins was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
